verdict.rationale: ADP's API Central lets developers create integration projects with their own security certificates [adp-run-docs-33, adp-run-docs-38]. Each project gets only the APIs a developer assigns or picks from use-case templates [adp-run-docs-34, adp-run-docs-36, adp-run-docs-37], and access is gated by OAuth 2.0/OpenID Connect [adp-run-docs-35]. Together these suggest credentials scoped per project to selected APIs, but the evidence never describes fine-grained permission scopes (such as read-only or limited data domains) or agent-specific credentials, and does not confirm that API Central covers RUN specifically. Missing for 10: explicit least-privilege scope or permission controls, read/write granularity, credential revocation and rotation details, agent-oriented credential issuance, confirmation that this works with RUN, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
